test_cases.source_text: I absolutely love this product! The quality exceeded my expectations. The customer service team was incredibly helpful when I had questions about my order. I've already recommended it to all my friends and family. Five stars!

Terrible experience from start to finish. The product arrived damaged and took three weeks to ship. When I tried to get a refund, I was put on hold for over an hour. I will never buy from this company again and I'm filing a complaint with the BBB.

The product works as described. Shipping took the standard amount of time. The packaging was adequate. Price was comparable to other options on the market. Nothing particularly stood out, but nothing was wrong either.

The product itself is fantastic - great build quality and works perfectly. However, the delivery was a nightmare. It took 2 weeks longer than promised and customer service was unresponsive. I love the item but probably won't order again due to the logistics issues.
The product quality is excellent and it works perfectly. Shipping was delayed and customer support took too long to respond, but I'm very happy with the purchase and would definitely order again.
Quick delivery and the item was exactly as pictured. The seller even included a handwritten thank you note which was a nice touch. Will definitely be a repeat customer. Great value for the price!

test_cases.clean_text: The product was okay I guess. Anyway, the shipping was slow but the packaging was decent.

test_cases.source_text: The laptop arrived on time and the build quality is solid — the keyboard feels good and the display is crisp. On the downside, the battery drains faster than advertised and the fan runs loud under any real load. The software came bloated with trials I had to uninstall. Overall I can see why some people like it but the issues are real enough that I'm not sure I'd buy it again.

Paid €74.99 in total, which included €24.99 for expedited shipping. The order still arrived 3 days late. Worse, the package contained only 2 of the 5 items I ordered. Customer service apologized and offered a €8.50 partial refund — barely a tenth of what I spent.

I bought this router from NetGear but it was drop-shipped by a third-party seller called ConnectPlus. The router itself worked fine. The problem was ConnectPlus — they charged my card twice and took 11 days to respond. NetGear support was actually helpful and escalated it quickly, but ConnectPlus never issued the refund.

I can't say I wasn't impressed. When I first unboxed it I thought the design was unremarkable, but after a week of daily use I can't find a single fault. The battery life is not inconsiderable — easily two full days — and performance hasn't let me down once. Not a cheap option, but not one I regret.

I wish I could say this met my expectations, but it didn't. I'd love to tell you the build quality justifies the price — it doesn't. If only the customer support had been able to help, but they weren't. It would be great if I could recommend this to anyone. I can't.

The unboxing experience was genuinely impressive — premium packaging, a thoughtful quick-start guide, and accessories that felt like they belonged. Setup was smooth and the interface is intuitive. For the first two weeks everything was great and I was recommending it to coworkers. Then the main board failed completely. The replacement unit arrived with a cracked housing. Support has not responded in 18 days. Do not buy this.

Placed the order on March 1st. The estimated delivery was March 5th. On March 8th I was told the item hadn't shipped yet. It shipped March 12th and arrived March 19th — nearly three weeks after I ordered. By then I had already bought a replacement elsewhere. I returned it immediately. The refund still hasn't appeared after 14 days.

test_cases.source_text: This is the best coffee maker I've owned. Brews fast, keeps coffee hot for hours, and cleanup is simple. Bought it six months ago and use it every day with no issues.
test_cases.summary: The customer is very satisfied with the coffee maker. They highlight fast brewing, good heat retention, and easy cleanup. They have used it daily for six months without any problems.

test_cases.source_text: The tent poles snapped on the second camping trip. Waterproofing failed in light rain. The zippers jammed. Returning it and buying a different brand.
test_cases.summary: The customer had a poor experience with the tent. The poles broke on the second use, the waterproofing was inadequate in light rain, and the zippers failed. They are returning it and switching brands.

test_cases.source_text: Good noise cancellation and comfortable fit. Battery lasts about 20 hours. The app is a bit clunky but workable.
test_cases.summary: The customer praises the noise cancellation, comfort, and 20-hour battery life. They also mention that the headphones came with a free carrying case and that customer support was excellent.

test_cases.source_text: The screen calibration was off out of the box and colors looked washed out. I returned it after two days.
test_cases.summary: The customer was happy with the screen calibration and found the colors vivid and accurate. They kept the monitor after a two-day trial.

test_cases.source_text: The manufacturer's warranty is 2 years but the retailer, QuickShip, only offers 30-day returns. QuickShip's customer service was dismissive. The manufacturer's support line resolved my issue in one call.
test_cases.summary: The manufacturer offers a 30-day return window and their customer service was dismissive. QuickShip's support line resolved the issue quickly, and their warranty covers 2 years.

test_cases.source_text: Ordered 3 units. Two arrived damaged. The seller offered a 15% discount on a future order instead of a refund for the $120 I spent.
test_cases.summary: The customer ordered 3 units and all three arrived damaged. The seller offered a 20% discount rather than refunding the $120 purchase.
